decision_rule: Exploratory expanded 24-log screen, 24 paired logs x four arms, frozen corpus and pinned worker Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-MTP-Q8_0 and production-consolidated-v10 CPU kernel. The paired pilot observed verified-quote minus control +0.06458 accuracy; 24 independent pairs have worst-case paired standard error 0.204; source correlation can increase it, so do not claim a statistically established effect or promotion. Complete 96 unique matched cells with captured evidence and answer text, all parsed below 1024 tokens, unchanged control and 24/24 planted mismatch rejections: report arm accuracy, matched outcomes and retained evidence; compare verified-quote and control descriptively. Stop on invalid control/linkage, stopfile/deadline, 2700s cap or operational futility; incomplete/truncated/invalid captures are INCONCLUSIVE, never gate success. Original per-log reference is capped at ten failed IDs with substring matching; disclose this limit. Sample is exploratory and nonrepresentative. For a valid complete run, file descriptive PASS if verified-quote mean accuracy >= control; otherwise file descriptive FAIL/STOP for this scoped screen. Missing validity is INCONCLUSIVE; no significance or production decision. Report original 12 and added 12 separately as well as combined; reused pilot cases are not independent confirmation. Record source-campaign clusters and separate added cases by provenance; do not treat same-campaign cases as independent groups. Checkpoint after each verified-quote cell from the fourth onward; stop on declared operational futility or after the full 96-cell screen. This is not an interim success gate. Record exact-string failed-ID recall as a separate report-only companion to the primary substring scorer; preserve the capped-10 gold denominator and primary futility/decision rule. Report accepted quote versus fail-open fallback counts and refetch-request counts by arm; retain fallback cells in the primary denominator. R5 output contract: result_path contains R5 treatment cells only; the owner must load and verify out/results.r3-native.jsonl SHA-256 59b4358cfdb709bf3b14a0781803d6595080b3045c8c0133b830b3e836ba7266 plus result_path, then reconcile 96 unique cells before any verdict while preserving both exec IDs and CPU affinities. No standalone 72-cell comparison and no served-latency claim. Retained control view spill pointers name R3 scratch while new treatment view pointers name R5 scratch; preserve that path distinction with the split execution IDs and CPU affinities. This is not a single-execution comparison and supports no served-latency claim. Separately inspect out/run-events.r5.jsonl and require a matching non-dryrun exec-ID preflight with valid linkage and unchanged control code plus a valid pass_complete event, in addition to the R3 seed and 96-cell treatment/result reconciliation, before any verdict.
notes: Resume the same 24-case corpus using the immutable 24-control R3 seed and any genuine R4 treatment cells (R4 produced none). R5 native result_path starts empty; never merge the R3 seed into it. R4 is retained as predecessor history: its initial dry-run recorded a validation-incomplete 25/96 grid and exit 3; its successful qualification emitted a dry-run verified-quote cell; the real grant ended rc=75 reason=disk-floor under rowflow’s unchanged 150 GiB floor. R5 uses a fresh dry-run stream. Qualification requires exactly one new dryrun=true verified_quote cell in that stream; job.py returns cleanly after that one cell without COMPLETE. Dry-run smoke evidence does not establish real execution. Any later verdict requires separate matching non-dryrun preflight with valid linkage and unchanged control, valid pass_complete, seed hash and 96-cell seed-plus-treatment reconciliation. Split-run limitations, separate exec IDs/CPU affinities and scratch spill pointers must be reported. No promotion or served-latency claim.
